meta.title: About Us - Product Beers
meta.description: Meet the crew behind Product Beers. Product meetups for passionate people.

hero.label: The story
hero.description: It all started with a conversation between strangers talking about product. Now we're a growing community.

mission.title: Meet people
mission.description: There's lots of product people but there was no place to hang out. Now there is.

vision.title: Share
vision.description: Every event someone shares something interesting. No boring PowerPoints, no BS.

values.title: Good vibes
values.description: No egos, no hierarchies. Doesn't matter your title or company. We're all equals here.

team.label: The team
team.title: The people behind this
team.description: A bunch of friends who wanted a place like this and decided to make it happen.

cta.title: Wanna join?
cta.description: We're 130+ in the Telegram group. That's where we announce meetups.
